summary: Index existing recovery copies once by oauthOriginal instead of filtering every copy for each original. All guards and request ordering retained.

verified_lead.before: Each of N original nodes filters all M previously copied metadata records; no local cap.
verified_lead.after: One native Map groups the M records into arrays preserving their order, followed by N expected constant-time lookups. O(M+N) local indexing/lookup work and O(M) additional index references; no API count or end-to-end latency claim.
verified_lead.behavior: Duplicate groups are stored without rejection; existing duplicate length guard executes at the same node encounter. Unrelated duplicate groups are ignored. Zero-match allocation, first matching ID, parent-before-child construction, readonly old token, uploads/hash readbacks, original rereads and tree consistency checks remain in the original body.
